[{"insert":"1 1/4 Dumbbell Bench Press + Flat Bench DB Fly

This is a superset for the chest. The 1 1/4 dumbbell bench adds a quarter rep out of the bottom to pile up time in the hardest part of the press. Move into the flat bench fly to stretch the chest under a slow tempo and finish it off. Push both close to failure each set.
"}]
